summary: This sermon teaches that God wants to speak to His people and guide them into abundant life, but believers must intentionally take time to listen and learn to recognize the Shepherd's voice through intimacy with Him. The greatest barrier to hearing God is not His silence but our failure to listen, and once we hear, we must act in obedience.
key_points: God wants to speak to us and lead us into abundant life
Listening to God requires intention—we must slow down and tune in
We recognize God's voice by knowing Him intimately, not just seeking Him in emergencies
God speaks in many ways: intuition, conviction, dreams, Scripture, circumstances, and more
Acting on what God says is the most crucial part—obedience over certainty
big_idea: God speaks to His sheep through many means, but we will only recognize His voice and experience the abundant life He offers if we intentionally draw close to Him and obediently act on what He says.
title: PRAYER: Listening to God
